user_priority: Use high environment counts and available VRAM to improve throughput while preserving training exposure and update volume

historical_e4096_evidence.limitation: An earlier Q1 implementation and capacity test, not a completed 40000-iteration run of the new native v0.1 Q1/two-rank contract

measurement_requirements: Native full-data Q1 E4096 with original WM2048 and motion/KP imagination4096 H32
Eight real full-update iterations with all five optimizer and Adam counts, finite gradients, compile costs, steady iteration time and CUDA allocator peaks
Original process cleanup, OOM/boot/GPU identity, and unchanged frozen input checks
Determine same-GPU shared capacity separately from single-robot capacity; no inference from E512 or environment count alone

training_selection.rule: Prefer measured high-capacity configurations; preserve or increase exposure and batch-update volume, record every scaling difference and measured throughput
training_selection.not_an_exact_release_recipe: Current integration uses the return KP student with jitter and the new Q1 command/mask/control contract; v0.1 README's current COMMON recipe uses copy without preview mixing and 60000 iterations, while the paper unified result reports 40000
